title: Development Support and Learning Support Programmes at Non-Anchor Operator Preschools
what_it_is: Development Support and Learning Support Programmes at Non-Anchor Operator Preschools

sections.label: Pre-school DS-LS programme growth
sections.summary: Pre-schools offering the DS-LS programme rose 60% from 350 in 2017 to about 550 today, with three regional providers serving non-AOP pre-schools.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The number of pre-schools offering the Development Support or DS, and Learning Support or LS programme has increased by 60% from 350 pre-schools in 2017 to about 550 pre-schools today.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Of these pre-schools offering the DS-LS programme, about 150 are non-Anchor Operator pre-schools.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Other pre-schools generally tap on regional DS-LS providers to deliver the DS-LS programme in their centres.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: There are currently three regional DS-LS providers namely, Asian Women's Welfare Association or AWWA, SPD and Thye Hua Kwan, providing the DS-LS programme at about 150 non-AOP pre-schools.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The Early Childhood Development Agency or ECDA is working closely with the regional DS-LS providers and pre-schools to expand outreach to more non-AOP pre-schools.

sections.label: Expanding DS-LS to non-AOP pre-schools
sections.summary: The 550 pre-schools are about 30% of pre-schools, and MSF teams are working to expand DS-LS provision to non-Anchor Operator pre-schools.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The 550 pre-schools I had mentioned earlier form about 30% of pre-schools.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I do not have the number or the exact breakdown of the number of children who do not have access to the DS-LS programme but I can come back at a later stage and provide those numbers to the Member.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I understand where the Member is coming from, and indeed, the early intervention teams at MSF are looking to work closely with the AOP and Partner Operator Scheme or POP providers to expand the LS-DS provision and also working with the regional therapy teams at the three regional DS-LS providers that I mentioned earlier, to expand their outreach and the provision of these services to the non-Anchor Operator pre-schools as well.
